question:
Choose the correct option to complete the sentence.

She tied the belt tightly around her ______
solution:
The correct answer is '**waist**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**waist**" refers to the part of the body between the ribs and hips, typically where a belt is tied. (कमर)
 
• In the given sentence, the context indicates that the belt is tied around a part of the body, which is the waist.
 
• The other options: "**waste**," "**weist**," and "**west**" do not fit the context or are incorrect spellings.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *She tied the belt tightly around her waist__.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Waste (अपशिष्ट)**: means material that is not needed and is discarded.
 
• **Weist**: is an incorrect spelling and has no meaning in this context.
 
• **West (पश्चिम)**: refers to one of the cardinal directions.
